rationale: The assistant correctly identified the unwashed pre-motor foam and felt filters as the likely cause, and gave safe wash and 24h dry instructions with unplugging and no motor work. In turn two it used the customer's evidence well and kept any replacement filter kit conditional on damage or staining that persists after washing. Minor issues: it re-listed some checks the customer had already done, a few claims were unverified (the 5-year guarantee, the 'monthly' rinse interval), and it asserted the cause as 'almost certainly' before the filters were washed.
